summary: Password-reset security fix RETEST — ALL GREEN. EMERGENT_EMAIL_KEY is now provisioned in /app/backend/.env; the previously-blocked registered-email happy path now works end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/auth/forgot-password with the registered account returns HTTP 200 {"ok":true,"delivered":true} with NO 'code' field in the JSON body; unregistered email still returns 404 with the exact Italian detail 'Nessun account trovato con questa email.'. Pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset_security.py now runs 3/3 tests PASSED (the previously-skipped test_no_code_in_response executes and passes). Frontend /reset-password verified on 390x844: unregistered email displays the Italian not-found message cleanly (no raw HTML); registered email advances to the code step with the info banner 'Ti abbiamo inviato un codice via email...' and the reset-code TextInput is EMPTY (not pre-filled).
critical_code_review_comments: Security fix fully validated: (a) unregistered email → 404 with the exact Italian detail, (b) registered email → 200 with delivered:true and NO 'code' key in the JSON body (asserted both on the raw text and on the parsed dict), (c) full reset flow (forgot → read code from Mongo → reset-password → login with new pw → old pw rejected) works, (d) frontend reset-code TextInput no longer auto-filled and starts empty.

Minor test-isolation fix applied to /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset_security.py: added `pytestmark = pytest.mark.xdist_group('password_reset_security')` so pytest-xdist keeps all 3 tests on the same worker (previously the FullResetFlow test could race with the TestForgotPasswordRegistered assertion on the shared password_resets record for REG_EMAIL, causing an intermittent xdist-only failure). Sequential run and grouped-xdist run both pass 3/3.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_password_reset_security.py (added xdist_group marker to serialize the module and prevent race on password_resets record)

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 pytest passed; direct curl verified 200 + delivered:true no code, and 404 with exact Italian detail)
